_comment: Template for mcp_apps/willow-bot/manifest.json — the steward as its own
principal (sealed 163b9a70, dispatch 4326FDFE). Not consumed by any code
path directly: manifest.create (verb 18 / manifest_grant_request,
42DF2EA1) writes the LIVE manifest under a sealed Nestor pair naming
these exact seats/groups, then signs it — this file is the reference
copy an operator/auditor reads to see what that sealed pair should say.
Groups, and why each is here (none is full_access, none is orchestrator,
grove_relay is never granted):
steward_sweep   — seal_drain, net_authority_drain, envelope_retire_sweep,
gitsync_sweep, git_pull_execute (gate.py). Tick-time
maintenance that mirrors a human's own prior seal or
action; mints no new authority.
steward_read    — human_required_list. Read the queue before deciding
whether to add to it.
steward_enqueue — human_required_enqueue only (never resolve, never
human_attestation_create). The steward raises a hand;
it does not clear its own queue item.
grove_read      — the 13 Grove read tools (channel/message/thread/
flag/bus/agent listing).
grove_write     — the 7 Grove write tools, GRANTED SEPARATELY by pair
f46474ee, not baked into this template — the steward
joins receive_dispatch's grove_read+grove_write grant
as the seventh seat. Listed here so the shape is
complete once that pair lands; the group name alone
carries no authority until a signed manifest holds it.
Deliberately absent:
full_access, orchestrator, dispatch_write/dispatch_send (any group
naming dispatch_send) — see dispatch 4326FDFE's handoff, item 5: the
steward enqueues a human_required ask for the desk to dispatch instead
of dispatching itself. grove_relay — a message a human reads on #willow
from the steward says willow-bot, never a relayed identity.
Fixture text for the sealed pair (willow-manifest-grant-v1 grammar,
manifest_grant_executor.py):
willow-manifest-grant-v1 seats=willow-bot groups=steward_sweep,steward_read,steward_enqueue,grove_read,grove_write
